description: This file contains functions for checking and performing firmware upgrades on different hardware platforms within the OpenWrt project. It defines functions 'platform_check_image' and 'platform_do_upgrade', and uses a case statement to select the appropriate upgrade method based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function to check if the firmware image is valid; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Function to perform hardware-specific firmware upgrade steps based on the board name.
